answer.evidence: Review metrics.py:32–66 and 120–141 for downstream scope: Halstead excludes nested functions, while maintainability uses total complexity. Review raw.py token analysis for source-metric consistency. The flattening implementation in complexity.py:78–94 qualifies children with block.name and updates emitted inner-class methods' classname. Check method closures carefully: qualifying from name rather than fullname can omit the owning class. In visitors.py:278–292, function traversal retains visitor.functions but does not retain visitor.classes, so classes defined inside functions may disappear before flattening.
